site.title: Testigo: fictional AI and neurotechnology case demonstration
banner: Prototype with synthetic data. Not an official reporting channel. Do not submit real information.
exit.help: Opens another page quickly. It does not erase browsing history or other traces. With JavaScript enabled, you can also press Esc twice.
intro.heading: Try the form with a fictional example
intro.lead: This demonstration explores documenting possible AI and neurotechnology harms. Use invented data only. It does not handle real reports or provide support or follow-up. No account is needed.
intro.what.heading: What happens to your report
intro.what.1: Routine access is restricted to authorized staff. Server operators may have technical access. These controls reduce risks but do not guarantee anonymity.
intro.what.2: It is stored encrypted. Your contact details, if you choose to give them, are stored separately, with a different key.
intro.what.3: A program suggests categories and possible risks. {ai} Rules replace detected identifiers before analysis but can miss others. Results are suggestions for human review.
intro.what.4: The demo generates a case code and access phrase to illustrate the planned workflow. Follow-up is not available yet.
intro.risks.heading: Before you write
intro.risks.1: Do not enter real names, RUT numbers, phone numbers or addresses. Automatic detection can miss identifying details. Use invented examples only.
intro.risks.2: This prototype has no automatic deletion or withdrawal feature. Fictional data may remain until the demo operator deletes it.
intro.risks.3: If someone is in danger right now, call the emergency numbers first.
intro.ai.local: The analysis runs on the configured local server ({provider}). The demo operator must ensure it runs the model locally and does not forward text.
intro.ai.mock: This demo uses a simulated program (Mock) without sending text to an AI provider.
intro.ai.cloud: Text is sent to the configured provider ({provider}) after rules replace the identifiers they detect. Other identifying details may remain. Use fictional cases only.
intro.ai.unavailable: The configured model could not be confirmed. Check with the demo operator before submitting an example.
emergency.heading: If someone is in danger right now: contacts in Chile
form.heading: Your fictional example
form.region.note: Only if it happened in Chile.
form.contact.heading: Demonstration contact (optional)
form.contact.help: Use an invented contact only. This illustrates a planned workflow; nobody will contact you through this demo. Without contact permission this separate field is not stored. Do not include contact details in the narrative.
form.contact.value: Fictional email, phone number or username
form.passphrase.heading: Your secret phrase
form.passphrase.help: The phrase illustrates access planned for a future version; follow-up is not working yet. Do not reuse a real password. Leave it blank to generate six words. At least {min} characters.
form.passphrase.label: Secret phrase (optional)
form.consents.heading: Your permissions
form.errors: Please check what is marked below.
pii.heading: Your text seems to contain details that could identify someone
pii.choice: Remove any real details before continuing. Only fictional examples may be sent. The original is stored encrypted; the analysis copy replaces detected identifiers but may miss others.
pii.edit: Check the text below and send it again.
unavailable: We couldn't receive the report right now. What you wrote is not lost: it is still in the form. Please try again in a few minutes.
unavailable.form: The form isn't available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
toomany: Too many reports were sent from this connection in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.
done.heading: We received your fictional example
done.passphrase.chosen: The phrase you chose (we don't show it).
done.save: The code and phrase illustrate planned access; these credentials cannot be recovered. They do not provide follow-up in this version. Your browser can retain traces of the visit even though the page requests no cached copy.
done.next.heading: What happens now
done.next.1: The example is available in the demonstration dashboard. No support, response or human review is guaranteed.
done.next.2: Later you'll be able to see the status of your case with your code and your phrase. This isn't available yet in the prototype.
done.support.heading: Support
done.danger: Your report mentions a possible risk to someone's life or safety. If so, call now:
done.print: To print, use your browser's Print option.
error.heading: Something went wrong
error.lead: We couldn't show this page. If you just submitted an example, it may have been saved even without a confirmation. Go back to the start.
notfound.heading: We couldn't find this page
notfound.lead: The address may be mistyped. From the start page you can reach the form.
expired.lead: The form expired or couldn't be verified. Open it again and try again.
footer: Testigo is an open-source prototype. It is not an official reporting channel.
language.name: English
